Hornbill dads wall the female into the nest with mud

scenes.headline: Once the eggs hatch she breaks out - and the chicks may be walled in again
School nature clubs
scenes.body: Want one at your school? Ask your teacher to DM us.

caption:
Ask a nature club kid about hornbills. We dare you.

This walled-in nesting is true of every hornbill species except the two ground hornbills.

Source: Britannica. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Student-creator UGC ad for school nature clubs: the kid's enthusiasm is the product proof, the hornbill fact is the payoff. Student is a placeholder - film only with guardian consent and a teacher present.
